jobs.description:
**Job Description**: Develop sim2real reinforcement learning (RL) training pipelines for humanoid robots. Train and test robot policies via reinforcement learning for in-home humanoid robots. Optimize training pipelines for improved performance and training speed. Modeling of physical systems (including robot dynamics, sensor modeling, contact parameter tuning) to close the gap between simulation and physical systems. Collecting, cleaning and retargeting human motion data for use in RL training pipelines. Supporting the test and debug of RL policies in simulation and on physical hardware.  
  
**Requirements**: Master’s degree or foreign degree equivalent in Robotics, AI/Machine Learning, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and one (1) year of experience in a Robotics & Machine Learning occupation or related in the job offered.  
  
**Skills:**  
  
Experience and/or education must include:

* Rigid body dynamics and/or dynamical systems for training, deploying and testing reinforcement learned policies for humanoid robots.
* Implement production-grade Python code for reinforcement learning (RL) and other machine learning training pipelines.
* Reinforcement learned algorithms, techniques, and sim2real approaches as they pertain to robotics to perform various human-like capabilities, including whole-body loco-manipulation.
* Implement and debug real-time software in C++ deployed on robots to satisfy various real-time constraints.
* Model physical systems, including multi-body hybrid dynamic systems with contact, in a simulated environment to identify gaps between simulation and hardware and the ability to understand how to accurately model the hardware in simulation.
* Root-cause analysis as it pertains to robotic systems and the ability to quickly troubleshoot issues.
* Forward and inverse kinematics as they pertain to humanoid system training using human motion data.

Compensation Range: $130,146 - $300,000

* Learn how the whole platform runs, service by service, and become the person who can answer where anything happens and why.
* Own the unattended layer: the services, workers, scheduled jobs, queues and integrations that run without anyone clicking.
* Own the data layer in production: schema changes, migrations and backfills with rollbacks, and tenant isolation that holds up under review.
* Own reliability and security: observability, incident response, secrets and access, and getting us ready for an outside review.
* Answer feature briefs from the principal and the senior developer with a contract they can build against, then build your half.
* Ship every week in small reviewed pull requests, and write the short design note before the code when a change deserves one.

* Data: Postgres with hand-written SQL migrations and row-level security; Redis for leases and queues; SpiceDB for authorization
* Frontends you will wire into: Next.js 15 and 16, React 19, our own design system.
* Tooling: GitHub Actions on self-hosted runners, Vitest against a real Postgres, an OSV supply-chain gate.

Nice to have:

* Transactional email or SMS at volume: webhooks, bounces, suppression lists
* Authorization systems such as SpiceDB or OpenFGA
* Legal-tech, compliance or regulated-data experience
* Enough React to connect a backend door to an existing screen; no design work is expected

Why join us:

**About Groq**

Inference is the engine that powers AI, and Groq was built from the silicon up to deliver the world's fastest inference at scale. We pioneered the LPU—the first processor designed specifically for AI inference—and are transforming that innovation into a global cloud platform powering production AI workloads.

  

With the capital, infrastructure, and team to execute, we're uniquely positioned to define the next era of AI infrastructure. The opportunity is massive, and it's still wide open. Now let's go build it!

**Mission:**

GroqMetal is building the infrastructure platform that turns large-scale physical compute into a reliable, isolated, customer-consumable product. As a Kubernetes Platform Engineer, you will build and operate production software within the GroqMetal platform, helping deliver Kubernetes as a commercial product for customers running large-scale AI training and inference workloads.

  

You will own meaningful platform components, work alongside experienced infrastructure engineers, and develop deep expertise in Kubernetes, distributed systems, and large-scale AI infrastructure.

  

**Location:** This role will be based in one of our three hiring hubs: the **Dallas, San Francisco, or New York City area**. The person hired for this role must be based in one of these three areas. You’ll have the flexibility to work remotely while we establish our local Groq office, with the expectation that this role will transition to onsite once the office opens.

  

**Responsibilities & opportunities in this role:**

* **Build production Kubernetes platform capabilities:** Implement APIs, controllers, operators, automation, and platform services that support the GroqMetal product by extending Kubernetes.
* **Own components end to end:** Take responsibility for well-defined platform capabilities from design and implementation through testing, deployment, operation, and continuous improvement.
* **Operate what you build:** Improve reliability, observability, performance, and operational efficiency, and participate in diagnosing and resolving production issues.
* **Build a Kubernetes platform as a commercial platform:** Develop capabilities used by dedicated customers running large-scale AI training and inference workloads.
* **Develop distributed systems expertise:** Build software that handles retries, failures, concurrency, reconciliation, and changing infrastructure state correctly.
* **Improve the platform:** Identify reliability, scalability, and usability problems and work with the team to deliver durable solutions.
* **Collaboration is a core skill:** Work within a team of experts to elevate the collective efforts of our team. Collaborate with engineers across infrastructure, inference, networking, infosec, and related teams to integrate platform capabilities holistically.
* **Grow your technical scope:** Contribute to design discussions, engineering practices, and technical decisions while developing toward ownership of increasingly complex platform systems.
  

  

**Ideal candidates have/are:**

* **Software engineers first:** Experience designing, implementing, testing, shipping, and maintaining production software.
* **Hands-on Kubernetes experience:** Experience building or operating Kubernetes-based systems, including areas such as controllers/operators, CRDs, cluster lifecycle, node management, scheduling, networking, or platform services.
* **Production infrastructure experience:** Experience operating software in production and debugging problems across application, Kubernetes, networking, compute, and infrastructure layers.
* **Solid distributed-systems fundamentals:** An understanding of failure handling, retries, idempotency, consistency, reconciliation, availability, and recovery, with an interest in developing deeper expertise.
* **Experience with disciplined software development:** Comfortable with code review, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, deployment, and production operations.
* **Product-minded infrastructure engineers:** Experience building Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, or platform capabilities consumed by customers is highly valued, but not required.
* **Hands-on experience with modern development tools:** Experience using coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, or similar tools in substantive engineering work is valued.
* **Interested in the AI infrastructure domain:** Experience with hyperscalers, neoclouds, GPUs, accelerator infrastructure, or AI workloads is valuable, but candidates with strong platform engineering fundamentals can develop this expertise in the role.
* **Comfortable growing through ambiguity:** Able to independently solve well-scoped problems, ask good questions when requirements are unclear, and work with senior engineers on broader architectural decisions.
  

  

**Why Join Us:**

* **Purposeful Hiring**: You’re not here by accident, and neither is anyone else. Every teammate is handpicked with intention because who we build what matters.
* **Builders Wanted**: You’re not just riding the rocket ship, you’re building it. Your work directly shapes the trajectory of our company.
* **Mission-Driven Work**: We’re here to make a real impact. Our mission fuels everything we do.
* **Tackling Hard Problems**: If easy isn’t your thing, you’re in the right place. We solve some of the most complex and exciting challenges in our space.
* **Excellence Is The Standard**: High performance isn’t just encouraged, it’s the baseline. And it’s contagious.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Compensation:**

Groq is committed to providing competitive compensation through our Total Cash philosophy, which incorporates potential bonus value directly into base pay. The total cash salary range for this position, which is inclusive of the potential bonus value, is $184,800 - $302,500, with individual placement determined by your geographic location,
